[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:06,000"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":6000},"text":" I llavors a veure, tu quan saps que tens un termini per fer les coses, doncs..."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:05,480"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":5480},"text":" I, evidentment, si has de dir alguna cosa, ho dius a les sessions que tens intern."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:04,000"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":4000},"text":" i llavors li toca el meu marit ser darrere de contes, i és així."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:06,000"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":6000},"text":" a mi em posa moltíssim, perquè a més era al principi i pensava que m'hagués quedat."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:04,160"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":4160},"text":" d'esqueles que van fer, les van passar, vull dir, que va ser així."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:05,960"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":5960},"text":" Jo penso que totes les parts implicades a nivell de totes les parròquies"}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:02,800"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":2800},"text":" i les decisions que em perpugui tirar endavant,"},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:02,880","to":"00:00:05,560"},"offsets":{"from":2880,"to":5560},"text":" amb tot el que era la justícia, l'immigració."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:06,480"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":6480},"text":" Vull dir, nosaltres entraiem en una proporcional nacional."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:04,000"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":4000},"text":" Però bueno, la corrent aquesta jo crec que ja era a mi imperable."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:04,200"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":4200},"text":" Això és el seu, i a bon resultat que clar, això era aviam, potser va a..."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,800"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3800},"text":" i es va obligar, i, bueno, les hores, doncs,"}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,800"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3800},"text":" i es va obligar, i, bueno, les hores, doncs,"}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,840"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3840},"text":" I ells evidentment em donaven el seu pare."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,120"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3120},"text":" em van convèncer, doncs, perquè fos candidat."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:07,920"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":7920},"text":" i nosaltres, malgrat que no vull dir que no volguéssim de cap manera."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:05,480"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":5480},"text":" d'en Durrana. És a dir, que el poble ens va a elegir per això."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:05,600"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":5600},"text":" perquè teníem la poder a veure si ara s'ho duré in extremis."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,000"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3000},"text":" l'objectiu tenia molt clar que s'hi jugava molt."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:05,640"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":5640},"text":" I jo crec que un factor important és el canvi generacional, també, entreu."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:05,040"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":5040},"text":" Evidentment van treballar, ho vam separar per comissions."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:05,400"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":5400},"text":" O sigui, al fondo el que es buscaveré tindrà una independència com a país."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,960"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3960},"text":" perquè si no s'arriba a fer la Constitució i continuem..."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,400"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3400},"text":" Ara toqui. Portava menys a l'arradera de la reformeta,"},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:03,480","to":"00:00:05,280"},"offsets":{"from":3480,"to":5280},"text":" de no sé què, que no s'acaba."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,680"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3680},"text":" que no hauríem d'anar per endorra."},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:03,800","to":"00:00:05,760"},"offsets":{"from":3800,"to":5760},"text":" És a dir, que no haguéssum demanat mai d'una certa manera."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,680"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3680},"text":" i després també a nivell d'agricultura."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,120"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3120},"text":" A veure, què és l'exemple del 92?"}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,040"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3040},"text":" i un bombé que prenia les mides."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:05,000"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":5000},"text":" perquè els coprínsecs, i sobretot els representants,"}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:05,600"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":5600},"text":" És a dir, que el que vam disfrutar molt va ser que hi va haver un ambient molt temps,"}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:06,520"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":6520},"text":" segurament. A veure, el goprínsem Martí, nosaltres no el criticarem."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:05,000"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":5000},"text":" Jo crec que el que es volia era trobar la manera d'arribar."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,000"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3000},"text":" que eren les llicències de fet o amb pares."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:04,200"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":4200},"text":" i de competències que en francès en diguem regalient."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:02,280"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":2280},"text":" Tinc els noms, que evidentment no us els donaré."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:02,920"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":2920},"text":" molt grans perquè abans no els deixaven votar, que eren..."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:05,280"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":5280},"text":" que volia donar una reformeta més arregladeta."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:06,120"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":6120},"text":" perquè no em vull ascendre amb les coses de palacio que hi van molt després."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:06,320"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":6320},"text":" La diferència és que la reformeta tractava amb assaig."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,280"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3280},"text":" I ho recordo perquè no crec que era la ràdio,"},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:03,360","to":"00:00:05,360"},"offsets":{"from":3360,"to":5360},"text":" no sé si havia televisió en aquest moment."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:05,600"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":5600},"text":" que de fet ens vam reunir, vam fer seminaris al tertè, vam fer seminaris..."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:05,400"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":5400},"text":" permanent, diguem sovint que és llàstima que no haguéssim allargat el lloc de..."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,520"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3520},"text":" Per tant, finances, evidentment, pels pressupostos i..."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:04,200"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":4200},"text":" i ho veiem, continuem com estàvem, que hem estat molt bé fins ara."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:04,840"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":4840},"text":" com veia perquè ell, clar, l'edat que té nieve i tanta època."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:05,040"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":5040},"text":" i va donar entendre que Sant Marino era Itàlia, de fet."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:01,000"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":1000},"text":" No era igual."},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:01,080","to":"00:00:04,440"},"offsets":{"from":1080,"to":4440},"text":" Doncs conyes que realment té un valor de cada institució."},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:04,520","to":"00:00:05,560"},"offsets":{"from":4520,"to":5560},"text":" Jo trobava..."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:04,400"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":4400},"text":" Vam fer una feina, i llavors es van decidir tots."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:04,360"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":4360},"text":" que es volien els 4 a nivell nacional i l'aconseguiria."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:05,000"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":5000},"text":" però que no siguis un club, diguem-ho així."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:05,800"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":5800},"text":" i que véssim també d'autodisoldre per la incapacitat de poder tirar endavant."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:02,400"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":2400},"text":" A veure, aquí que el diu una cosa."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:02,880"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":2880},"text":" No entenc massa, però bueno, no seré jo qui la canvio."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:05,680"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":5680},"text":" perquè jo crec que hi ha alguns que em donen la sensació"}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,480"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3480},"text":" com estaven, doncs evidentment no era el nostre tarannà."},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:03,560","to":"00:00:04,560"},"offsets":{"from":3560,"to":4560},"text":" Per almenys el meu."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:04,800"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":4800},"text":" Bé, vull dir també, perquè cal recordar-ho."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:01,000"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":1000},"text":" i es van anar."},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:01,080","to":"00:00:05,160"},"offsets":{"from":1080,"to":5160},"text":" És a dir, aquí poc temps abans hi havia hagut una autodissolució."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:05,560"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":5560},"text":" de sort, però realment jo crec que l'esperit de la gent no hi ha ni pensat."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:04,280"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":4280},"text":" I, de fet, no em va portar ningú, jo em vaig portar..."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,760"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3760},"text":" perquè tampoc ho hauria de massaclar i com podia anar."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:04,840"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":4840},"text":" I, bueno, l'últim, la psiga 4 que ens vam apuntar i vam dir que era capaç."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,560"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3560},"text":" Aquí, aquí, els pasos perduts, el cas que aniva bé, un..."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:05,160"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":5160},"text":" Això és d'edat, i clar, això ja li teníem posat al cap."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:05,000"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":5000},"text":" perquè has tancat l'aport a les 7 de la tarda."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,360"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3360},"text":" que ja estem bé com estem i no ho toquem, que tot es fa molt bé."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:02,520"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":2520},"text":" Si veiem interès per què, clar,"}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:06,880"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":6880},"text":" normalment es revia amb... amb interès, diguem, es revia amb interès."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:04,440"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":4440},"text":" perquè recordeu que en aquella època els balles tenien una força..."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:06,360"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":6360},"text":" perquè, clar, vull dir, tothom veia les exigències que tenien al sol."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:04,840"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":4840},"text":" per tant, clar, pot dir, més que a nivell familiar va ser posar..."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:05,680"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":5680},"text":" Em va venir a veure, perquè, clar, ja sabia de començar a preparar,"}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:04,680"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":4680},"text":" O com pot ser, vull dir, crec que pot ser fàcil, no?"}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:02,440"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":2440},"text":" i moltes persones de la cor antenna, diguem, no?"}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:04,600"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":4600},"text":" que el país vol dir-ho necessitàvem."},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:04,680","to":"00:00:06,720"},"offsets":{"from":4680,"to":6720},"text":" Vull dir que estàveu fent de reformeta,"}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:04,600"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":4600},"text":" Però, esclar, també d'entendre que si volíem tirar endavant."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:04,840"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":4840},"text":" jo no crec que s'hagi de canviar massa, massa sovint d'una constitució."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:05,280"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":5280},"text":" perquè hi havia molts endorrans reticents."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:06,000"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":6000},"text":" És a dir, fer un estat de dret modern amb la separació de poders."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:06,640"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":6640},"text":" Tot i que les relacions entre en Gàmels i altres parroquis"},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:06,640","to":"00:00:09,440"},"offsets":{"from":6640,"to":9440},"text":" no eren bones a nivell electoral no s'havia perdut."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:06,000"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":6000},"text":" i els consellers a veure i companys diputats de l'Assemblea Nacional de França o BD Madrid."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:05,720"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":5720},"text":" el coprincipat. El coprincipat ens ha vingut molt bé i pensàvem que aquest hauria de continuar i així ens ha sigut."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:10,000"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":10000},"text":" fos una mena d'eleccions ja amb un objectiu més clar que anar més enllà de les reformes que s'està fent,"}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:05,000"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":5000},"text":" i dic \"opi, vols que ens trobem que ens parlen d'això i ens proposin això?\""},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:05,000","to":"00:00:09,000"},"offsets":{"from":5000,"to":9000},"text":" Doncs nosaltres ja hem d'anar, hem de fer la Constitució."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:04,480"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":4480},"text":" A més enllà, ens va costar fer aquest pas important,"},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:04,560","to":"00:00:08,360"},"offsets":{"from":4560,"to":8360},"text":" després, evidentment, entrem a la legislatura crítica"},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:08,440","to":"00:00:10,440"},"offsets":{"from":8440,"to":10440},"text":" o a la més forta que hi ha."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:05,000"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":5000},"text":" A tu disseri, ens vam quedar una mica parats perquè nosaltres volíem anar més lluny."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,040"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3040},"text":" Vull dir que era el nou reglament, el nou sistema."},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:03,120","to":"00:00:05,560"},"offsets":{"from":3120,"to":5560},"text":" Veius les dues coses, penso que la Constitució..."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:08,400"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":8400},"text":" Bé, marxar. Una cosa que em va satisfir molt va ser que vaig fer desíndic, diguem-ho així,"},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:08,600","to":"00:00:11,800"},"offsets":{"from":8600,"to":11800},"text":" durant una hora o més."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:04,160"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":4160},"text":" I, doncs, quan va arribar el consell constituent,"},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:04,240","to":"00:00:06,720"},"offsets":{"from":4240,"to":6720},"text":" ha vint arribar també amb bastant tensos"},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:06,800","to":"00:00:08,320"},"offsets":{"from":6800,"to":8320},"text":" i l'enriquia es van posar."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,840"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3840},"text":" I jo era així, i a bon dia ja, des de llavors,"},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:03,920","to":"00:00:08,480"},"offsets":{"from":3920,"to":8480},"text":" encara cada any es fa el dia 2 de febrer,"},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:08,560","to":"00:00:13,440"},"offsets":{"from":8560,"to":13440},"text":" fem un dinar o un trobar de tot el constituent."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:08,480"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":8480},"text":" Després, clar, quan va arribar cap al final de tot, ens van informar més."},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:08,480","to":"00:00:12,200"},"offsets":{"from":8480,"to":12200},"text":" Perquè a final havíem de votar que sí, sinó..."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,920"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3920},"text":" Vull dir que una setefesó personal, sí que aquí mateix,"},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:04,000","to":"00:00:10,960"},"offsets":{"from":4000,"to":10960},"text":" com he dit abans, perquè sabia que hi havia tensions entre els copríncepts."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,720"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3720},"text":" per dir-ho a nivell de negocis, el que sigui, això va molt bé."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:04,000"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":4000},"text":" No està bé considerada com un estat real."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:04,840"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":4840},"text":" però la meva motivació, us ho dic clar, va ser..."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:06,040"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":6040},"text":" Bé, jo crec que l'atac de nacionalisme que ens va moure..."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:05,400"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":5400},"text":" O sigui, en Dorre, malgrat ser un dels parlaments,"}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:02,720"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":2720},"text":" sobretot perquè els delegats permanents han continuat."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,920"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3920},"text":" o com vulguis, segueixen contentat amb una reformeta."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:05,480"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":5480},"text":" Ja et dic que els agents exteriors siguin ja no vull dir quins, però..."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,600"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3600},"text":" fins a la prostitució no ja està bé."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:04,200"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":4200},"text":" i ho explicarà, doncs jo crec que a aquest home va voler marcar..."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,040"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3040},"text":" Evidentment, la siniciatura, claro."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:02,040"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":2040},"text":" perquè això era xins."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,360"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3360},"text":" Jo crec que he pogut entrar en càrregues."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:02,920"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":2920},"text":" que tu et trobaves i, de fet, el meu pare el portarà sempre sobre què hi pinc."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:01,760"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":1760},"text":" que es poden fer més en positiu."},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:01,880","to":"00:00:03,160"},"offsets":{"from":1880,"to":3160},"text":" Evidentment hauria sigut un daltabaix,"}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:04,640"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":4640},"text":" perquè considero que en d'hora necessita un nou estatut com..."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:06,440"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":6440},"text":" Bé, jo crec que hi havia persones més receptives"}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:11,000"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":11000},"text":" Al principi es va començar amb 38 alumnes i clar amb els 5 o 6 anys que jo vaig col·laborar amb l'escola endurrana va anar a créixer."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,880"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3880},"text":" als pares jo crec que van fer una feina molt important"},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:03,960","to":"00:00:05,960"},"offsets":{"from":3960,"to":5960},"text":" amb aquells primers anys de l'escola en d'Orrana."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:04,600"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":4600},"text":" I aquest material pedagògic, que tingués continuïtat,"},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:04,800","to":"00:00:07,200"},"offsets":{"from":4800,"to":7200},"text":" també de cara a tota la primera ensenyança."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:04,600"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":4600},"text":" amb la responsabilitat, amb les persones que hi treballàvem, evidentment,"},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:04,800","to":"00:00:07,000"},"offsets":{"from":4800,"to":7000},"text":" per dir, és que això no és una cosa per ara,"}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:06,320"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":6320},"text":" i per tant parlaven amb altres pares perquè portessin els fills a l'escola en Dorana."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,680"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3680},"text":" a l'escola, més que res, perquè tenia els nens petits."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,160"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3160},"text":" Bueno, el 15 més 15 és una idea que venia de nada."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:05,280"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":5280},"text":" per mi l'escola andorrana és una identitat no, jo crec."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,680"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3680},"text":" crec. És a dir, tots els alumnes que hem sigut repetits"}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:01,720"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":1720},"text":" No ho veiem perquè..."},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:01,800","to":"00:00:04,480"},"offsets":{"from":1800,"to":4480},"text":" No ho veiem perquè per un luxe d'anar-ho a veure i per conservar-ho."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:06,000"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":6000},"text":" o bé el que considerem imprescindible i no deixa de ser innecessari."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:05,400"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":5400},"text":" amb la qual estava bastant clar, semblava bastant clar."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:02,160"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":2160},"text":" que tenen senyor o, evidentment,"},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:02,240","to":"00:00:07,560"},"offsets":{"from":2240,"to":7560},"text":" en una sèrie de condicions molt clares,"},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:07,640","to":"00:00:09,640"},"offsets":{"from":7640,"to":9640},"text":" d'un nombre de persones."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:01,000"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":1000},"text":" Allò."},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:01,080","to":"00:00:04,480"},"offsets":{"from":1080,"to":4480},"text":" Clar, llavors, el caçador recollitor que està en un lloc fos,"},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:04,560","to":"00:00:05,560"},"offsets":{"from":4560,"to":5560},"text":" que és la cova..."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:06,160"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":6160},"text":" o sigui, què et motiva de la teva professió?"}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:02,800"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":2800},"text":" I volem avançar dins del camp, molt bé."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,000"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3000},"text":" A part de les patates o les tronfes, que diguem a Canillo."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:04,440"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":4440},"text":" Són fideles, doncs, és a dir, amb el dia a dia i amb Espanya."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:05,480"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":5480},"text":" perquè, normalment, quan t'inviten a nivell oficial, t'inviten a tal..."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:02,880"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":2880},"text":" A veure, vostè com es diu?"}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:06,200"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":6200},"text":" Bé, no que t'espai físicament, però que t'espai emblemàtic."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:05,520"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":5520},"text":" Si hi ha cel, jo no crec ni en l'infern, ni en el purgatori, ni en el cel."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:02,920"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":2920},"text":" Llavors, els catalans han volgut..."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,080"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3080},"text":" O sigui que les identitats com les cultures"}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:05,400"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":5400},"text":" Vull dir que amb això, vull dir que vostè, a través..."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:04,640"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":4640},"text":" és a dir, ja no hi ha el diàleg, ja no hi ha la..."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:02,520"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":2520},"text":" i ara ja no ens ho pot dir."},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:02,600","to":"00:00:04,920"},"offsets":{"from":2600,"to":4920},"text":" Però van anar a veure l'amistat amb el meu pare."},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:05,000","to":"00:00:07,240"},"offsets":{"from":5000,"to":7240},"text":" El meu pare els va anar a veure després o així."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,760"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3760},"text":" A vosaltres hi havia de més feia de... de més..."},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:03,840","to":"00:00:05,480"},"offsets":{"from":3840,"to":5480},"text":" Sí, de més de descompte."},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:05,560","to":"00:00:07,560"},"offsets":{"from":5560,"to":7560},"text":" Bueno, de més de descompte..."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:01,000"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":1000},"text":" i el país."},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:01,080","to":"00:00:03,800"},"offsets":{"from":1080,"to":3800},"text":" Clar, però feia falta aquesta visió,"},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:03,880","to":"00:00:06,960"},"offsets":{"from":3880,"to":6960},"text":" adelantar-se els aconteixements, vull dir."},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:07,040","to":"00:00:08,040"},"offsets":{"from":7040,"to":8040},"text":" Sí, també."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:02,840"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":2840},"text":" M'agradaria que no hi havia res."},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:02,920","to":"00:00:06,440"},"offsets":{"from":2920,"to":6440},"text":" Jo crec que en aquella època, pràcticament tot devia ser necessari,"},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:06,520","to":"00:00:10,840"},"offsets":{"from":6520,"to":10840},"text":" per la falta, precisament, de tot el que hi havia aquí al país."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,000"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3000},"text":" que no havia, avui dia, a Calarenya i al Cíndic General,"},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:03,080","to":"00:00:05,880"},"offsets":{"from":3080,"to":5880},"text":" per fer una mica de publicitat d'endorra."},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:05,960","to":"00:00:07,640"},"offsets":{"from":5960,"to":7640},"text":" Diguem que endorra era un poble."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,800"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3800},"text":" I el servei de servei, o sigui, tot té creació de nou serveis."},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:03,880","to":"00:00:07,480"},"offsets":{"from":3880,"to":7480},"text":" I, a més, dels serveis que eren necessaris en aquell moment."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:06,760"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":6760},"text":" d'aquí, no venia a guanyar alguna pèl·la, perquè volien desprotar la gent."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,400"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3400},"text":" I, bueno, era la primera fase."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:04,160"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":4160},"text":" i portant mai a la vida sabades, perquè ho veig."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:05,120"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":5120},"text":" Però a nivell nacional, volia dir, per 89,"}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:05,200"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":5200},"text":" que dintre d'això hi havia punts essencials, evidentment,"}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,760"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3760},"text":" Ja t'ho dic tot, perquè no em vull ascendre."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:06,000"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":6000},"text":" La diferència és que la reformeta tractava amb missatges."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:02,520"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":2520},"text":" A veure, aquí que el diu una cosa."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,680"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3680},"text":" Jo tenia molt clar que s'havia de canviar la manera de fer."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:05,200"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":5200},"text":" perquè jo crec que hi ha alguns que em donen una sensació"}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,440"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3440},"text":" com estaven, doncs evidentment no era el nostre tarannà,"},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:03,520","to":"00:00:05,040"},"offsets":{"from":3520,"to":5040},"text":" per almenys el meu."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:02,120"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":2120},"text":" els quadrenys perquè, lògicament,"}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:02,640"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":2640},"text":" i estem d'acord? Doncs vam tirar endavant."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:04,720"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":4720},"text":" Bé, vull dir també, perquè cal recordar-ho."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:05,000"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":5000},"text":" però que no siguis un club, diguem-ho així."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:04,320"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":4320},"text":" I llavors això planava molt sobre, sense que es digués, molt."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:04,160"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":4160},"text":" molt poc temps, perquè tot això es va fer al tomb de 8 mesos, o sigui."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:02,680"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":2680},"text":" Quan se vol, a nivells de programes polítics,"}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,600"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3600},"text":" per nosaltres, que se ens van apropant, diguem, per vosaltres."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:05,400"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":5400},"text":" i resòria, perquè no podíem acabar mai de decidir que una cosa..."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,680"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3680},"text":" i demitots que gràcies a Déu que vull dir a l'Adri."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:01,000"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":1000},"text":" sin enviure."},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:01,080","to":"00:00:05,480"},"offsets":{"from":1080,"to":5480},"text":" És a dir, que nosaltres podíem dins que volíem ser com un pa..."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:06,320"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":6320},"text":" Jo penso que totes les parts implicades a nivell de totes les parròquies,"}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:01,000"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":1000},"text":" és on els primers."},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:01,080","to":"00:00:04,880"},"offsets":{"from":1080,"to":4880},"text":" Nosaltres teníem clar que havíem de fer el pas."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:07,000"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":7000},"text":" Però vam anar molt a l'il·lusió, perquè la Constitució, nosaltres, realment, és el que ens interessa."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:04,600"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":4600},"text":" per fer les decisions com per poder tirar endavant amb tot el que era la justícia,"}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:06,800"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":6800},"text":" Vull dir, nosaltres entraiem amb una proporcional nacional."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,680"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3680},"text":" És a dir, que sempre hi ha aquesta incognita i, evidentment,"}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,440"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3440},"text":" d'un aspecte, eh?, a veure, i que les eleccions són del 92..."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:07,400"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":7400},"text":" que es vegués. No depenia del Govern, el vam crear, crec que l'hem 84."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:04,960"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":4960},"text":" dos legislatures que van ocupar 4 anys, de fet."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,160"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3160},"text":" en aquests moments perquè els copríncets,"},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:03,240","to":"00:00:05,520"},"offsets":{"from":3240,"to":5520},"text":" sobretot els representants, perdien..."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:06,400"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":6400},"text":" És a dir, que el que vam disfrutar molt va ser que hi va haver un ambient molt temps, però gràcies."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,000"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3000},"text":" No vol dir que a nivell laboral la néixer."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,520"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3520},"text":" i això és el que ara començarem a veure."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:02,080"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":2080},"text":" Bueno, te n'has d'anar. Bueno, va."},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:02,160","to":"00:00:03,760"},"offsets":{"from":2160,"to":3760},"text":" Amb una cantina..."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:02,120"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":2120},"text":" que no li ha agradat, eh?, sempre que li n'hi ha bé,"},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:02,200","to":"00:00:04,080"},"offsets":{"from":2200,"to":4080},"text":" però jo sé per què, mudada."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,080"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3080},"text":" que hi ha una cosa que jo crec que és importantíssima,"},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:03,160","to":"00:00:04,320"},"offsets":{"from":3160,"to":4320},"text":" que és el vinó."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,280"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3280},"text":" i després hi havia el factor, evidentment, diferent."},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:03,360","to":"00:00:04,880"},"offsets":{"from":3360,"to":4880},"text":" Se'l deprem, clar, que no."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:01,000"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":1000},"text":" -Exacte."},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:01,080","to":"00:00:03,600"},"offsets":{"from":1080,"to":3600},"text":" -Bueno, llavors comença tot una agradació."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:01,480"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":1480},"text":" Diuen que és..."},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:01,560","to":"00:00:05,000"},"offsets":{"from":1560,"to":5000},"text":" Bueno, hi ha una frase que diu \"El pot petit i la bona comfitada\"."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:02,840"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":2840},"text":" que el va callar, jo crec que has tallat el pernil."},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:02,920","to":"00:00:03,920"},"offsets":{"from":2920,"to":3920},"text":" Sí."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:04,760"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":4760},"text":" i aquesta bata, que a canilló en diguem una brusa."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:05,000"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":5000},"text":" Avui és un bon dia perquè amb una copa de bombi a la mà ens desperta."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,440"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3440},"text":" que ells donaven, és a dir, que s'instaureix"},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:03,520","to":"00:00:06,600"},"offsets":{"from":3520,"to":6600},"text":" entre el món polític i el món empresarial un diàleg..."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,680"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3680},"text":" que ara farem, que jo crec que ens ajudarà molt a nivell de finances."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:05,000"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":5000},"text":" A veure, aquesta opinió de que s'obren"}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:04,280"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":4280},"text":" Bé, treballem una cosa que amb una il·liogràdia que ja ha donat..."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,760"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3760},"text":" Però clar, aquest és un primer basc i després donar tot el món."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,400"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3400},"text":" com sigui, doncs ho haurem de patir i s'ho haurà de fer,"},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:03,480","to":"00:00:04,960"},"offsets":{"from":3480,"to":4960},"text":" i si no, no en sortirem."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:04,600"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":4600},"text":" Ella és la que va crear els primers llavors."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,280"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3280},"text":" perquè vam començar l'any 65."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,400"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3400},"text":" No s'ha tornat a veure amb els anys."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:05,400"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":5400},"text":" Bé, ara ens exercitarem amb l'exercici de la memòria."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:04,880"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":4880},"text":" I clar, vostè, amb 97 anys, té molts records,"}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:09,000"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":9000},"text":" la família, jo crec que és l'escència de viure bé i en pau."}]
[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:02,600"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":2600},"text":" per programar el record, o sigui, a la vida."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,920"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3920},"text":" És a dir, que el Dorre de Bordelel,"},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:04,040","to":"00:00:05,800"},"offsets":{"from":4040,"to":5800},"text":" en cap d'aquests temps."}]

[{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:00,000","to":"00:00:03,760"},"offsets":{"from":0,"to":3760},"text":" M'ho diu jo, molt bé, el cert que ve no el paradís,"},{"timestamps":{"from":"00:00:03,840","to":"00:00:06,040"},"offsets":{"from":3840,"to":6040},"text":" va en marxar del paradís, però..."}]
